accepted.sentence: Before lifting a vehicle, users often loosen wheel nuts slightly while the tire still rests on the ground.
A protective cloth between the jaws and polished plumbing can reduce marks while a fitting is turned.
A deep socket is chosen when a long exposed stud would otherwise prevent the head from seating fully.
When a bolt turns along with its nut, a second tool can hold the bolt head stationary.
Penetrating oil is often given time to reach corroded threads before force is applied to a stuck fastener.
Some bicycle pedal threads loosen by turning clockwise on the left side, opposite the usual direction.
Once initial resistance has been overcome, users may remove a loose nut by hand rather than continuing repeated turns.
A socket extension lets the user's turning force reach a recessed fastener behind an obstruction.
